plain: Taking over land or a people by force.

webster.text: The act of conquering; the act of overcoming or vanquishing opposition by force, physical or moral.

example.quote: But the greatest governments which have appeared on the face of the globe have been founded in conquest.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 11, 1787 and the following sittings (Elliot prints no later date headings) (2d ed. 1836)
